overview: The Medford Commission for Persons with Disabilities approved its June meeting minutes, elected a new slate of officers, and planned to request ARPA funding for an intern. Commissioners also agreed to consult city officials regarding an Architectural Access Board variance notice.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the amended meeting minutes from June.

items.title: Election of Officers
items.summary: The commission unanimously approved a slate electing Tom Hamel as Chair, Linda Smith as Vice Chair, and Megan as Secretary.

items.title: Architectural Access Board Variance Notice
items.summary: The commission reviewed a notice of a public hearing from the Architectural Access Board and agreed to seek advice from the city solicitor regarding its potential involvement.

items.title: Commission Goals and ARPA Intern Funding Request
items.summary: Commissioners discussed establishing long-term goals and agreed to draft a request for ARPA funds to support hiring a commission intern.

items.title: Public Participation and Announcements
items.summary: No members of the public spoke, and the meeting adjourned after confirming that the commission will not meet in August.
